plan.summary: Meta Leadgen process-lead handler currently swallows email/custom_1..5/consent canonical fields by routing through WaDirectIntakeRequest (phone+name only). This packet adds an in-process LeadIntakeService.IntakeMetaLeadgenAsync method that persists the full canonical set (email column + custom_1..5 in intake_metadata + consent gate). MetaLeadgenEndpoints.cs:494-501 swaps to the new method; behaviour for legacy WaDirect callers (Automation real-time WA inbound) is unchanged.
plan.q_intent: Codex audit raporunda dent-golive.html plan E.2 mapping veriyor (FULL_NAME/PHONE/EMAIL/custom_1=city/custom_2=prev_treatment/consent_marketing) ama process-lead handler sadece phone+name persist ediyor. Q karari (b): kod genislet — full canonical persist olsun, plan E.2 source slug 'meta-leadgen' field map devreye girsin, tum alan persist.
plan.interview_notes: Q kararlari 1A 2A 3A onaylandi: (1A) in-process service call — yeni internal HTTP endpoint YOK, MetaLeadgenEndpoints DI ile LeadIntakeService.IntakeMetaLeadgenAsync invoke. (2A) consent=false reject — LIW pattern (INV-BE-105 LeadIntakeConsentNotTrue). NOT: Meta form privacy URL + checkbox tasarim geregi consent=true gelir; tenant toggle (consent_required flag) post-pilot backlog. (3A) LIW canonical 'consent' kullan — MetaLeadgenConfigDto doc'undaki 'consent_marketing' etiketi 'consent'e indirgendi (no migration; field_id_map JSONB serbest, hicbir tenant henuz consent persist etmiyor cunku kayboluyor — backward-compat sikinti yok).

Mevcut WaDirect intake path'i (Automation /api/internal/leads/intake/wa-direct) davranis aynen korunur — IntakeWaDirectAsync ve EnsureLeadForWaDirectAsync dokunulmaz, regression yok. Smoke: Automation real-time inbound WA mesaji → leads UPSERT phone/name only (existing behaviour).
